nota: Versión en inglés del video 3 («We're not only marketing. Judito Ads.»). Tiempos sacados de las escenas reales; bloques de hasta unos 11 s que empiezan en un cambio de escena.

bloques.texto: Judo Marketing isn't just a marketing company.
For complex problems… we build complex solutions.
That's why we built Judito Ads. Here's how it works.
bloques.ve: That's why we built JuditoADS. Here's how it works ↓
bloques.como: Clear, like pointing at a whiteboard.

bloques.texto: Meta lets Judito Ads run your ads… with your permission.
bloques.ve: JuditoADS runs your ads, with your permission.
bloques.como: Calm and reassuring on «with your permission».

bloques.texto: Connect Facebook. Judito tells Meta what to do.
bloques.ve: Judito tells Meta what to do.

bloques.texto: You only pay Judo twenty bucks a month.
bloques.ve: You only pay Judo $20 a month.

bloques.texto: …and you pay it straight to Meta.
bloques.ve: And you pay it straight to Meta.

bloques.texto: We never touch your money or your budget.
How do you know it works?
bloques.ve: So how do you know it works?

bloques.texto: Meta tells Judito how your ad is doing…
bloques.ve: Meta tells Judito how your ad is doing…

bloques.texto: …and Judito gives you tips to sharpen your strategy.
bloques.ve: …and Judito gives you tips to sharpen your strategy.
bloques.como: Warm, like a friend giving advice.

bloques.texto: All you need: your Facebook, to log in… a Page… Instagram, if you have it… and an ad account with a card.
bloques.ve: All you need: your Facebook (you log in and give permission), a Facebook Page, your Instagram if you have one, and your ad account with a card.
bloques.como: Steady, one item at a time, a short pause between them.

bloques.texto: That's it. You're advertising like a pro.
bloques.ve: That's it. You're advertising like a pro.

bloques.texto: Try it free for fourteen days. And if you need help getting started, message me.
bloques.ve: Try it free. 14 days · no card needed → Need help? Message me.
bloques.como: Warm, the most human line of the video. Smiling.
